scripts.dev: set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; PYTHONPATH=${WECOM_GUI_PYTHONPATH:-} ${WECOM_GUI_PYTHON:-python3} -u -m cli_anything.wecom_gui agent --mode auto --poll 0.5 --scan-interval 1 --inbox-limit 5 --max-drafts 4 --last 12 --log-interval 5

scripts.queue: set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; PYTHONPATH=${WECOM_GUI_PYTHONPATH:-} ${WECOM_GUI_PYTHON:-python3} -m cli_anything.wecom_gui --json queue list --limit 20
